description: This is a Java test class for the KuraProtocolAdapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of mapping MQTT topics to internal resource identifiers, particularly focusing on control and data message handling, with various configuration scenarios.

classes.name: KuraProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the KuraProtocolAdapter, focusing on message mapping based on topics, QoS levels, and configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraControlMessagesToEventApi
methods.description: Tests that control messages with QoS 1 published from Kura gateway are mapped to the Event API endpoint.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraControlMessagesToTelemetryApi
methods.description: Tests that control messages with QoS 0 are mapped to the Telemetry API endpoint.

methods.name: testMapTopicRecognizesControlMessagesWithCustomControlPrefix
methods.description: Ensures that custom control prefixes in topics are properly recognized and mapped.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraDataMessagesToTelemetryApi
methods.description: Verifies that data messages with QoS 0 are correctly mapped to the Telemetry API.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraDataMessagesToEventApi
methods.description: Verifies that data messages with QoS 1 are forwarded to the Event API.

methods.name: assertAddress
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the mapped ResourceIdentifier matches expected endpoint, tenantId, and deviceId.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a mocked MqttPublishMessage with specified QoS, topic, and optionally payload.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Constructs a MqttContext with a given MQTT message, endpoint, and optional Device.
